module_summary: Complete IPv4 stack: an eth_type classifier with per-frame select registers routes incoming Ethernet frames to IP or ARP modules, whose outputs are merged by an arbitrated Ethernet mux; IP resolves MACs via ARP request/response.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet header valid, steered to IP or ARP by eth_type.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready muxed from IP/ARP ready by eth_type select.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Incoming Ethernet payload broadcast to IP and ARP receivers.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Incoming payload valid; gated by select registers to IP or ARP.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready muxed by select registers; drops unknown frames.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame; re-arms the classifier select registers.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet header valid from arbitrated IP/ARP mux.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet payload from arbitrated mux.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready for outgoing Ethernet payload.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing IP packet header valid into IP transmit path.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP payload to be framed and transmitted.

anchors.name: s_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Destination IP address resolved through ARP before transmit.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received IP header valid from IP RX parser.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received IP payload from IP RX parser.

anchors.name: s_select_ip_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame latch routing payload valid/ready to IP module.

anchors.name: s_select_arp_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame latch routing payload valid/ready to ARP module.

anchors.name: s_select_none_reg
anchors.why: Per-frame latch that drops non-IP/ARP payload by forcing ready.

anchors.name: s_select_ip
anchors.why: eth_type 0x0800 decode selecting IP header path.

anchors.name: s_select_arp
anchors.why: eth_type 0x0806 decode selecting ARP header path.

anchors.name: arp_request_valid
anchors.why: IP module request to ARP for MAC lookup of next hop.

anchors.name: arp_response_valid
anchors.why: ARP response valid carrying resolved MAC back to IP.

anchors.name: arp_response_mac
anchors.why: Resolved MAC from ARP cache used as destination MAC.

anchors.name: arp_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address being looked up in ARP cache.

anchors.name: ip_tx_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP module transmit header valid into output arbiter.

anchors.name: arp_tx_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: ARP module transmit header valid into output arbiter.

anchors.name: clear_arp_cache
anchors.why: Command to flush the ARP cache.

anchors.name: local_ip
anchors.why: Local IP configuration for IP and ARP modules.

anchors.name: tx_error_arp_failed
anchors.why: Reports packet dropped because ARP resolution failed.

groups.name: eth_type_classifier
groups.description: Decodes eth_type and latches per-frame select to route frames to IP or ARP.

groups.name: ip_module
groups.description: IPv4 RX parsing and TX framing with ARP-based MAC resolution.

groups.name: arp_module
groups.description: ARP cache, lookup controller and ARP request/reply generator.

groups.name: output_arbiter
groups.description: Arbitrates IP and ARP transmit frames onto single Ethernet output.

groups.name: eth_input
groups.description: Incoming Ethernet frame header and payload interface.
